title: Introduce tiered CI lanes with opt-in longtests and dependency coalescer
author: Logan Pierce
release_notes: Adds tiered CI lanes: fast-feedback (lint/unit/smoke), extended (integration/longtests opt-in), nightly longtest runner; introduces a dependency coalescer that batch-updates minor patches to reduce PR churn; quarantines flaky tests behind @flaky tag.
description:
Motivation: As our monorepo grows, pull requests get slow feedback because all checks run for every change. We observed increased CI cost and developer wait time for low-risk changes. This PR introduces a tiered CI model and a small dependency coalescer tool to reduce churn from frequent patch-level dependency updates.

Summary of changes: 1) Introduce three CI lanes: 
- fast-feedback: runs on every push and PR changed files (lint, unit tests, lightweight smoke). Designed to give <5m feedback for common edits.
- extended: opt-in by adding /run-extended (or adding label 'run-extended'). Runs integration tests and longer but important suites. Opt-in avoids blocking fast iteration for simple changes.
- nightly-longtests: scheduled nightly job that runs the full longtest matrix and regression prompt-evals.

2) Add dependency-coalescer: a small script (go) and GitHub Action that aggregates minor/patch-level dependency updates across the repo and opens a single coalesced PR weekly. The goal is to reduce PR noise and minimize CI runs for mechanical upgrades. Coalescer supports package manifests: package.json (node), go.mod, and pyproject.toml and respects allowlists.

3) Quarantine strategy for flakies: introduces a test tagging convention and a quarantine registry. Tests annotated with @flaky in pytest or // flaky in Bazel are skipped in fast-feedback and run in extended/nightly with extra retries so they don't block developers. A small opt-out policy allows critical PRs to force-run quarantined tests.

What I changed (high level):
- .github/workflows/ci-fast-feedback.yml: new workflow that uses path filters and change-aware test selection; adds cache warm-up and faster containers.
- .github/workflows/ci-extended.yml: new workflow that is label/command triggered and executes integration suites.
- .github/workflows/nightly-longtests.yml: scheduled nightly pipeline with longer timeouts and higher resource pools.
- tools/dep_coalescer/: new Go command and action wrapper + manifest processors (3 files).
- infra/scripts/selective-test-runner.py: improvement to detect affected test subsets (used by fast-feedback).
- tests/quarantine-registry.md: docs for annotating and triaging flaky tests.
- ci/README.md: doc updates explaining lanes, labels, and how to opt-in/out.

Commits (summary):
- 2a9f7b8: bootstrap dep coalescer (initial parser for package.json + pyproject)
- 7b3c1d4: add fast-feedback workflow and selective-test-runner integration
- 4f2a0e1: add extended workflow, label trigger and example configs
- 9c6a5d2: nightly-longtests schedule and runner resource tuning
- 0b3d9e5: quarantine registry docs and pytest marker support
- 1f8e6c0: tests and small fixes after reviewer feedback

Files changed (high-level snippets):
- .github/workflows/ci-fast-feedback.yml: reduced matrix, path filter rules, integration with selective-test-runner. Example: "runs-on: ubuntu-latest; steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v3; - uses: actions/cache@v3 ..."
- .github/workflows/ci-extended.yml: label-triggered workflow; uses larger runner pool and sets CONTEXT=integration.
- tools/dep_coalescer/main.go: parses manifests, groups upgrades, emits a single PR body with grouped changelogs.
- infra/scripts/selective-test-runner.py: adds changed file -> test mapping.

Tests and CI: initial run failed due to an uncovered Bazel cache invalidation in the extended matrix. I pushed a follow-up commit (1f8e6c0) that ensures bazel-remote is warmed before heavy integration runs. CI timeline: first run 2026-02-25: fast-feedback passed, extended failed (flake in integration/db-setup). Second run after fix 2026-02-27: all checks passed. Nightly pipeline run scheduled 2026-03-01 executed successfully.

Review conversation (highlights, chronological):
- Aisha Raman (review): "Love the tiered approach. Two asks: please ensure we have an easy override to run quarantined tests and make the coalesced PR include a manifest of bump details."
- Logan (author): "Added an override label /run-quarantined and included a per-package bump manifest in the PR body. See commit 1f8e6c0."
- Ethan Cole (review): "Concerned about accidental opt-out — can we make the label explicit and document the UX for release managers? Also please add integration smoke to fast-feedback for infra changes."
- Logan: "Added docs update in ci/README.md and a small rule: if files under infra/ change, fast-feedback will run the infra-smoke job."
- Marisol Vega (review): "Dep coalescer looks useful; add an allowlist and ensure we don't combine major bumps. Also request: add a Carbon copy to release managers for coalesced PRs."
- Logan: "Allowlist added (tools/dep_coalescer/allowlist.yaml) and coalescer will skip major semver bumps; PRs now ping the release-managers team automatically."
- Aisha: "Approved after docs and override added."

Accessibility and rollout plan: Gradual rollout over two weeks. Day 1: enable fast-feedback for all PRs. Day 3: enable infra-smoke detection. Day 7: enable opt-in extended lanes and run coalescer in dry-run mode (no PR) for one week to validate behaviour. Day 14: enable weekly coalesced PRs. A follow-up task (ENG-2460) was created to monitor developer velocity and noise metrics.

Observability: Added lightweight metrics emitted by the selective-test-runner and dep_coalescer: ci.lane.duration, ci.samples.per-pr, deps.coalesced.count. They appear in the console under CI / Pipelines -> Metrics.

Fallbacks and safety: If the coalescer produces a PR that fails tests, it will open a draft PR and add the label 'needs-attention'. Coalescer will not merge automatically. The quarantined tests are tracked in tests/quarantine-registry.md with owner pointers.

Release/merge: After approvals and green CI, merged via squash on 2026-03-04. Rollout tracked in ENG-2460.

Notes/Follow-ups:
- ENG-2460: monitor CI cost and PR latency after rollout.
- ENG-2475: add support to coalesce Dependabot PRs into the weekly bundle.
- Tech debt: consider migrating selective-test-runner mapping into a centralized test-index service.

If you want to preview the coalescer run locally: tools/dep_coalescer/README.md contains quickstart and sample outputs. For questions about labels/opt-in, see ci/README.md or ping @Logan.
